questions.text: What is the primary interface or application that needs to be built?
options: A customer-facing web portal with user authentication and billing integration
An internal operations dashboard for inventory and workflow management
A real-time data visualization tool for analytics and reporting

questions.text: What underlying data sources or backend architectures will this integrate with?
options: A relational SQL database connected via standard REST APIs
A microservices ecosystem communicating through message queues and GraphQL
A legacy monolithic backend requiring data migration and API wrapping

questions.text: What concrete outcome defines success for the first production release?
options: A deployed end-to-end prototype allowing initial users to input and retrieve records
A complete migration of core workflows to a new responsive interface with automated tests
A hardened release ready for external compliance and performance benchmarking
